provenance: SIMULATED, not captured from the app's engine. Hand-written to look like what a decent model replies to hearPrompt(): quotes copied word for word, the odd implicit ask missed, a withdrawn ask still listed, a repeated ask listed twice. It measures how the app's code treats a reply (the quote check, the safety net, the numbering), not how good any model is. To record real replies: node formal/asks/eval/run.mjs --mode live --live-cmd 'claude -p' --record formal/asks/eval/recorded/live.json
